attributes.title: Fetch Long Beach Veterinary Conference 2026
attributes.summary:
Fetch Long Beach 2026 takes place December 3 to 5, 2026, at the Long Beach Convention & Entertainment Center in California. dvm360 lists more than 70 CE sessions spread over 25+ learning tracks, including new 30-minute sessions worth half a credit each, plus an exhibit hall.

Three hands-on labs (tibial tuberosity advancement, patellar luxation and multimodal rehabilitation) need a separate registration. dvm360 lists 14 CE hours per person (seven on each of December 4 and 5), or up to 16 with sponsored meal sessions, pending RACE approval. Registration prices are not shown on the public pages; early-bird pricing ended October 2, 2026.
